title: InputMissing payload
description: A step names `{input.<name>}` and the run was not given `--input <name>=<value>`. Refused before a run id is allocated and again before the driver runs any step, with code `undeclared_reference` at the step's path and a message naming the placeholder (map.rs `StepMap::check_inputs`, drive.rs `start_with_host`, run.rs `Session::check_map`).
